title: Keeping Order Among Liars — The Crown of Mount Phyle
description: The Castro and Liskov protocol: four bandits on the crown, one who may lie, trained rats, and a loot scroll whose entries must stand in the same order in every honest copy.
question: Can a replicated service keep its commands in order when some of its machines lie, the leader included, and messages take arbitrarily long?
how: We find out by exploring how four bandits holding a hilltop kept one book of their loot when any of them, their chief included, might be lying.
